description: Danish company annual accounts: list the fiscal years of a Danish company whose XBRL annual report (Erhvervsstyrelsen, virk.dk publication index) has been decoded: closing dates, period, entity name, currency. Danish-taxonomy (fsa) filings only: IFRS/ESEF-only groups are not decoded, an empty answer does not mean no accounts exist. Legal persons only, the form read on the CVR profile: a sole proprietorship (ENK, PMV), an estate (DØD) or an undecided CVR form returns 404, not billed, as does a number unknown to the CVR or a name under objection (GDPR art. 21); without CVR access on the server, 503 registre_non_configure, not billed. No default-risk score is computed for this country yet: the response carries score_defaillance (statut non_evaluable, closed-list reasons explained by GET /v1/lecture); never read it as a low score. A filing's entity name under objection (GDPR art. 21) is served null and counted in ecartes.opposition (item kept, block partial in provenance). Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
